about.title: Built for calm recovery
about.body: CalmIq helps you understand everyday movement discomfort with clear, careful guidance. We are not a licensed clinic in the chat — when hands-on care matters, paid members can request a physiotherapist session.
about.disclaimer: CalmIq does not diagnose or replace professional medical advice. Seek urgent care for severe or sudden symptoms.

legal.privacyBody: CalmIq stores account, subscription, and session-request data to deliver the product. Chat may be processed by our AI provider. Do not share sensitive medical identifiers you are not comfortable storing.
legal.termsBody: CalmIq chat is educational wellness guidance, not diagnosis or emergency care. Physiotherapist sessions are fulfilled by humans after a paid request. Use of the service constitutes acceptance of these terms.
